plain_meaning: The group a person belongs to, such as college final year worried about placements. It is what selects the plan.
not_to_be_confused_with: Not a segment, persona or audience. We use one word: cohort.

plain_meaning: Our plan for a cohort: what we send, when, who calls and what we never say.
not_to_be_confused_with: Not the journey. The playbook is what we do. The journey is where they are.

plain_meaning: Where a person currently is, from New to Enrolled. Nine stages.
not_to_be_confused_with: Not the playbook, and not the CRM state. The CRM has 26 technical states which map into these 9.

plain_meaning: How well the course suits this person, out of 100. Based on facts about them.
not_to_be_confused_with: Not intent. Someone can be a perfect fit and completely uninterested.

plain_meaning: How close this person is to acting, out of 100. Based on what they do and say.
not_to_be_confused_with: Not fit. Someone can be desperate to buy a course they cannot take.

plain_meaning: What to do about them now, in plain words: Call now, Call today, Call this week, Automated only, Redirect, Do not contact.
not_to_be_confused_with: Not the intent score. Priority combines fit and intent and then applies the hard rules.

plain_meaning: One of the nine things we reason about. Each has a defined list of what it may and may not change.
not_to_be_confused_with: Not a field. A dimension is worked out from several fields.

plain_meaning: A check that stops something contradictory, impossible or commercially pointless from happening.
not_to_be_confused_with: Not a scoring rule. A guardrail blocks or warns, it does not add points.

plain_meaning: A raw piece of evidence: a form answer, a click, a reply, an event attendance.
not_to_be_confused_with: Not a dimension. Signals feed dimensions.

plain_meaning: Information exactly as it was captured.
not_to_be_confused_with: Not a derived field. Raw fields are never overwritten by calculations.

plain_meaning: A cleaned or standardised version of a raw field.
not_to_be_confused_with: Not derived. Normalising tidies a value, it does not calculate a new one.

plain_meaning: A value the system calculates from other fields.
not_to_be_confused_with: Not raw. Derived fields are recalculated and should never be typed in by hand.

plain_meaning: An output of the model: cohort, playbook, priority.
not_to_be_confused_with: Not derived. Classifications are decisions, not measurements.

plain_meaning: How much the system trusts a value: whether it was declared, inferred or unknown.
not_to_be_confused_with: Not the score itself. A high score with low confidence is a warning, not a green light.

plain_meaning: Not active right now, with a stated reason and usually a return date.
not_to_be_confused_with: Not lost. Parked leads have a reason and many have a date to come back.

plain_meaning: The fixed sequence of what to do when someone stops replying.
not_to_be_confused_with: Not a follow up schedule. Each rung responds to a different kind of silence.

plain_meaning: Whatever the ad, form or event told them they would get.
not_to_be_confused_with: Not a resource. The promise is the obligation. The resource is the thing.

plain_meaning: A thing we send: a guide, a class, a calendar, a fee sheet, a link.
not_to_be_confused_with: Not a message. The message is the words. The resource is the attachment.

plain_meaning: The exact place a lead came from, one of 45 values.
not_to_be_confused_with: Not the UTM first or last touch, which are for marketing reporting only.

plain_meaning: One full pass of the 18 steps that turns raw data into a cohort and an action.
not_to_be_confused_with: Not a score update. A score update is one step inside an evaluation.
